# `tests/fixtures/vault-corpus/` — materialized round-trip corpus

Generated by [`tools/corpus-extractor`](../../../tools/corpus-extractor/)
(Story 2.5, LD-44/OD-1). Do **not** hand-edit anything under `extracted/` or
`synthesized/` — regeneration wipes and rewrites both subtrees.

## Provenance & licensing

The org-text snippets in this corpus are **derived from the GNU org-mode test
suite** (`testing/lisp/test-org-element.el`, **GPL-3.0-or-later**), harvested
at a pinned release tag whose URL and SHA-256 are hard-coded in
`tools/corpus-extractor/src/fetch.rs` and stamped into both manifest headers
under `fixtures/`.

This corpus is **test data only**:

- It is never compiled into, linked into, or distributed with Orgsidian's
  MIT-licensed binaries (R-009 / LD-37 GPL-contagion posture).
- The upstream `.el` source file itself is **never vendored** into this repo —
  it is fetched at extraction time into a gitignored cache.
- Full rationale: `docs/adr/0001-corpus-subset-selection.md`.

## Layout

- `extracted/NNNN_<deftest-slug>.org` — one file per harvested assertion
  (full nightly corpus; `fixtures/full-nightly.json` points here).
- `synthesized/NNN_<bucket>-<recipe>.org` — deterministically composed
  medium/large + edge-bucket subset members (recipes recorded in
  `fixtures/subset-pr.json`).

## git-LFS

`*.org` files here are tracked via git-LFS (`.gitattributes`). To materialize
them: `git lfs install` (once) then `git lfs pull`. **The per-PR workflow does
not need this** — the L0 subset is embedded in `fixtures/subset-pr.json`; only
nightly/L2 work and corpus regeneration read these files. Tooling detects LFS
pointer stubs and reports the setup steps instead of mis-parsing them.

Ownership: `epic-2` (see `fixtures/fixtures.toml`). Mutations require a PR
tagged `[fixture:epic-2]` quoting the regeneration invocation + pin.
